_comment: cockpit.css overrides on top of cockpit-shell/tokens.css (local editable DS). Entries document intentional runtime divergences. See ADR-014.

allowedDivergences.reason: Intentional density tweak — 82% mix gives better legibility on the green accent.
Intentional calibration — 28% is more subtle on the bright green accent; 55% is too loud.
Intentional layout calibration (92px). Unit migrated to rem for scaling consistency.
fluid responsive chat rail — clamp() calibration (last @media breakpoint wins; rail fluidly resizes from default down to laptop/tablet).
fluid responsive chat rail — clamp() calibration (user-expanded width fluidly resizes per breakpoint; last @media value wins).
opacity overlay migrated to fixed charcoal hex — surface-0 = global background level (#060708) + 0% accent tint (Portfolio Premium).
opacity overlay migrated to fixed charcoal hex — staged opaque charcoal palette + 0% accent tint (Portfolio Premium).
opacity overlay migrated to fixed charcoal hex — staged opaque charcoal palette + 0% accent tint (Portfolio Premium).
opacity overlay migrated to fixed charcoal hex — staged opaque charcoal palette + 0% accent tint (Portfolio Premium).
Intentional readability lift — 0.48 fails WCAG AA on #000000. Raised to 0.70.
Intentional softening — 4% opacity for ultra-fine hairlines (Portfolio Premium).
Hearst Flow Figma white overlay #FFFFFF1A — replaces approximate rgba mix.
Hearst Flow Figma white overlay #FFFFFF33 — replaces approximate rgba mix.
Intentional redesign — shell shadow was too heavy. Replaced with a flatter, quieter drop shadow.
Intentional calibration — 220ms feels less snappy and more premium on glass surfaces.
New secondary accent token for muted elements (Portfolio Premium).
Typographic softening — reduced contrast for institutional premium feel (Portfolio Premium).

Intentional default-state override — cockpit.css pins the effective right-rail width to 0px (chat closed is the default layout; centering reads --ct-rail-right-eff). The package base derives it from the chat collapsed/expanded state via :has(); cockpit fixes the closed default. Not a regression.
